items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: I thought Freddie Kepper was one of the best we had in the business. Freddie Kepper.

ctx.x: Oh, I pushed a friend of mine. He's the one that made Louis. I guess you know that, don't you? Yeah, he made Louis. And Louis admits that too. He made Louis. That's a lovely player too, Joe Oliver was. He used to call him King Oliver, you know. But I never thought, I never see Joe in that light of calling him King. Freddie Kepper played with, played more principle and more ease, I thought, than all those players. Freddie Kepper. Jaws didn't swell. That's a nice thing. And Joe stayed something. That's a nice…
